create_character_metric: create a CharacTER metric instance to evaluate machine translation predictions against references
compute_cer_single_reference: compute character error rate for predictions with single references using mean aggregation
compute_cer_multiple_references: compute character error rate for predictions with multiple references and return the best score
compute_cer_aggregated: compute character error rate with sum or median aggregation and return all individual scores
get_metric_info: get CharacTER metric metadata including description, citation, and input schema features
